com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Record acknowledgement of a selected warning or information flag. This records your review decision; blocking errors still need correction. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview acknowledging the warning we selected, using its exact flag type and field. Explain what the acknowledgement records and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_acknowledge_invoice_warning, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare acknowledging a current warning or information flag. Errors cannot be acknowledged or bypassed. Requires confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
